description: This file defines a PHP trait named EndpointExceptionTrait, which provides utility methods for generating and throwing specific API exception instances related to HTTP errors and validation errors in the OrangeHRM API version 2. It encapsulates common exception handling patterns for use within API endpoints.

methods.name: getBadRequestException
methods.description: Returns a BadRequestException with a specified message, defaulting to a predefined error message.

methods.name: getNotImplementedException
methods.description: Returns a NotImplementedException with a specified message, defaulting to a predefined error message.

methods.name: getRecordNotFoundException
methods.description: Returns a RecordNotFoundException with a specified message, defaulting to a predefined error message.

methods.name: getForbiddenException
methods.description: Returns a ForbiddenException with a specified message, defaulting to a predefined error message.

methods.name: throwRecordNotFoundExceptionIfNotExist
methods.description: Throws a RecordNotFoundException if the given entity is null or does not match the specified class.

methods.name: throwRecordNotFoundExceptionIfEmptyIds
methods.description: Throws a RecordNotFoundException if the provided array of entity IDs is empty.

methods.name: getInvalidParamException
methods.description: Returns an InvalidParamException for one or more invalid parameters, each represented by an InvalidArgumentException with a message.
